verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 is a data-center GPU, a hardware accelerator, not an agent or application that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the H200 itself connecting to MCP servers. Ecosystem software such as NIM, CUDA and Brev is not documented as an MCP client either, and would not transfer to the GPU anyway.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
